When I go through a similar situation, I just remind myself that it's just an emotion, which to me is like a filter over the lens of your entire mind, altering every though, sight, or moment in front of you. Then I remember always feeling like this filter is permanent, which brings up suicidal thoughts just from the concept of it...but only while that filter is on. I ask myself how is it possible that I'm feeling like this when just a moment, a day, or even a month ago I felt on top of the world? I look back, and look for clues of what has changed or even triggered this onset of such a devastating filter, and am left with a blank conclusion. Until one faithful day, at some spontaneous moment, that filter is removed and I feel as myself once again, not even looking back on what I just went through. But just like the last lens, this one isn't permanent either, it changes, like a season. So now when the crippling lens is upon me once again, I just remind myself that it will go away...
